trial: Two-episode automation trial approved by the founder 2026-10-01: hard US$5 image-generation cap per episode. Both switches ship OFF; nothing here spends or publishes until the founder turns a switch on.
episodes_note: At most 2 count (nyx_runner.TRIAL_MAX_EPISODES). A Fanvue chapter enrolled with parent <episode> shares that episode's cap. The second trial slot is open for the next approved lock.

image_generation.note: Official OpenAI Images API via openai_image_provider. The key is stored only by `pbpaste | python3 openai_runtime.py store` (gitignored .openai_runtime/, chmod 600). The cap can be lowered here, never raised above nyx_runner.TRIAL_HARD_CAP_USD.

auto_publish.note: Only routes in nyx_runner.PUBLISH_ROUTES marked verified can publish. Instagram/TikTok stay held until a media-hosting route is verified; Threads/X stay held (channels.py).
